notes.title: Launch Check v1 build
notes.body: Claude Code plugin that scans an app before launch and helps fix it. From docs/07-milestones.md.

notes.title: Empty score is null, verdict "No checks yet"
notes.body: When no applicable checks ran, score is null instead of 0 or 100; runs also store verdict and counts.notImplemented.
notes.considered: 0: reads as a failing app. 100: reads as ready.

notes.title: Repo root is the plugin root
notes.body: plugin.json, skills/, engine/, catalog/ at the root; docs/ and fixtures/ are dev-only.
notes.considered: A launch-check/ subfolder: catalog would need copying or a ../ path.

notes.title: Slash commands are built as skills, no commands/ folder
notes.body: Current Claude Code docs mark commands/ as deprecated.

notes.title: Spell checking uses Hunspell (WASM) with Hspell's Hebrew dictionary
notes.body: hunspell-asm loads Hebrew in 0.3s; flags a word only if unknown, used once, and one edit from a known word.
notes.considered: nspell: over 2 minutes to load Hebrew. A plain word list: Hebrew prefixes make it useless.

notes.title: Severity counts are per check, not per finding
notes.body: A check failing on 3 pages is one blocker, matching passed/skipped which were already per check. Also added top-level checks map and runs[].changes to state.

notes.title: Local scans always start their own copy on a free port
notes.body: Never reuse a server already on the usual port: in M1 another project's server sat on the port and the scan read the wrong app.
notes.considered: Reuse a running server (docs/02): risks scanning a different app.

notes.title: Form checks need consent and a local or staging target
notes.body: Flag: --consent submit-forms. Skipped checks record needs: submit-forms so the skill knows what to ask. Writes are answered by Launch Check itself where possible.

notes.title: A rotated key in git history is closed as accepted risk
notes.body: Launch Check can't verify rotation from outside; the user confirms and the finding is accepted with reason key rotated.

notes.title: Consent to side effects lasts 12 hours
notes.body: A yes to test submissions carries over to rechecks in the same working session; a scan next week asks again.

notes.title: Each fix starts from a clean tree
notes.body: fixing refuses while there are uncommitted changes, so every fix is its own commit and can be undone alone. Found in the walkthrough when two fixes ended up in one commit.

notes.title: Bot protection is 'couldn't tell', never 'fail'
notes.body: Vercel/Cloudflare challenges are recognised by header or page; checks that saw them answer uncertain, a challenged home page stops the scan, and Launch Check never tries to get past a challenge.

notes.title: Hebrew spelling flags only strong signals
notes.body: Words spelled differently from a word the site repeats, and doubled letters. Prefix and ו/י variants are never flagged: the dictionary misses too many valid forms.

notes.title: No automatic fixing: scan, report, discussion, user's go, fix
notes.body: Claude never fixes on its own initiative. Each finding is discussed; approved fixes go on pending.fix; fixing starts only on the user's explicit go and the engine refuses anything not approved.
notes.considered: Bulk 'Fix my N now' (docs/04 original): fixes things that may be intentional, like slang the owner chose.

notes.title: The tool is called Sofia
notes.body: Plugin sofia, commands /sofia:check and /sofia:fix; triggers on the name (Sofia / סופיה) so it isn't confused with other checker skills. Internal names (.launch-check/, engine) unchanged for now.

notes.title: Report page look: calm neutral grays, indigo accent, red/amber/gray severity
notes.body: Neutral zinc-like surfaces (#f7f7f8 page, #fff cards, #18181b text) with a separate indigo accent (#4f46e5); severity red/amber/gray and verdict green per docs/05; system fonts, tabular numbers, mono paths; dark mode follows the OS. My call, following docs/05's 'calm, utilitarian' direction.
notes.considered: Brand-colored page: competes with the severity colors. Custom webfont: docs/05 forbids external requests.

notes.title: Reviewer: something that doesn't exist in the app = pass ('Doesn't apply'), not uncertain
notes.body: Came out of a consistency run where two reviewers split on this. Uncertain is only for something that exists but can't be decided.

notes.title: A reviewer's answer is accepted only if every quote is on the exact line in the code
Skill landing pages — inspiration scan
notes.body: Single-skill pages: impeccable.style (hero promise + before/after demos + 30 testimonials + 3-step install). Directories: skills.sh (ASCII logo, one install command, agent logo grid, install leaderboard), ui-skills.com (curated cards), claude.com/skills (benefit list, use-case groups, customer logos). Audience-match: VibeSafe / Nullsec (vibe-coder security scanners: plain English, score, 'here's what's broken, here's the fix').

notes.title: Sofia's repo will be public
notes.body: Owner wants people to install it; public GitHub repo + marketplace.

notes.title: How Impeccable reached ~94k stars
notes.body: Facts: pbakaus/impeccable created 2025-11-16; 93.9k stars, 5.5k forks (gh, 2026-10-29). #1 GitHub Trending all languages in early March 2026 (~7k stars/week), 82 days on trending. Author Paul Bakaus: jQuery UI, Chrome DevTools, AMP, Google for Creators. Later a16z seed + bundled with GitHub Copilot app. My read (not sourced): known author, named a shared pain ('AI slop'), visual before/after proof, commands named as verbs (polish, bolder, critique, audit), works in every agent, free.

notes.title: Which checks use which library
notes.body: Built (77): playwright-core 13MB for 29 browser checks (axe-core 3.3MB only a11y.button-names, a11y.contrast); htmlparser2 for every site check, 16 need only it; hunspell+dictionaries ~11.5MB only content.spelling; 19 no library; judgment none. Remaining 98 (40 browser, 47 mechanical, 11 judgment): expected to need no new big library — ~40 Chrome, ~17 htmlparser2, ~30 Node built-ins only, 11 reviewer. Open: leftover.dead-code (own simple version vs knip), mail.spam-score (external service?), launch.sitemap-submitted (can't verify without Search Console).

notes.title: More skills like Impeccable — stars and pages
notes.body: Stars via gh 2026-10-29: obra/superpowers 308k (README only); mattpocock/skills 306k (aihero.dev/skills, docs-style); anthropics/skills 185k; ui-ux-pro-max 142k (uupm.cc, numbers as proof); garrytan/gstack 138k (README, tools framed as team roles); taste-skill 105k (tasteskill.dev, npx install in hero + 5 full-page demos); claude-mem 104k (claude-mem.ai, did not load); gsd 64k; BMAD 55k; emilkowalski/skills 51k (emilkowal.ski/skill, plain list + course upsell); vercel agent-skills 33k; SuperClaude 24k; ibelick/ui-skills 10k. Pattern: the top two have no designed landing page; README/one-liner carries it.
